CustomField.description: Indicates if the document submitted by the customer is of the accepted quality
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check if the image of the identity document captured by the customer is clear, legible and complete: 1) All required fields for a DVS check are visible and manually extracted for data entry, 2) For photographic IDs, the image quality will allow for a reliable selfie match, 3) If applicable for the Document Type provided, the full document has been captured - both front and back. For selfie matching tips, failure scenarios and acceptable exceptions, refer to the procedural guide.
CustomField.label: Acceptable Document Quality?
